name: RED-100
summary: RED-100 is a two-phase noble-liquid detector programme for coherent reactor-antineutrino scattering. It operated a xenon target at Kalinin and subsequently prepared an argon phase to reduce delayed-electron backgrounds.
detection_principle: Recoil ionization electrons are drifted through liquid and extracted into gas, where electroluminescence amplifies the charge signal. The few-electron response permits low-threshold searches, with delayed single-electron backgrounds requiring detailed control.
